structure: Part 15, Templates: all 12 traces of templates.fit.spec.js, every one opened and mined (actions, page snapshots with eval of main text, links, controls and classes, and the page-level network log). Traces, referred to below by their zip name without the templates-- prefix: manage-templates-lists-the-saved-templates-with-view-and-use-actions (T1), manage-templates-the-dashboard-use-template-button-opens-manage-templates (T2), a-saved-template-view-the-template-answers-with-a-change-link-per-section (T3), a-saved-template-use-starts-a-new-draft-notification-from-the-template (T4), a-saved-template-change-one-section-save-and-return-goes-back-to-the-template (T5), a-saved-template-posting-to-a-template-page-just-reloads-it-and-an-unknown-template-returns-to-the-list (T6), a-saved-template-edit-opens-the-template-on-its-own-task-list (T7), a-saved-template-delete-confirm-then-the-list-says-it-was-deleted (T8), create-a-new-template-type-name-answers-review-save (T9), create-a-new-template-a-template-with-no-name-is-saved-as-untitled-template (T10), create-a-new-template-discard-a-template-being-created (T11), create-a-new-template-the-discard-page-outside-a-template-journey-returns-to-manage-templates (T12). Page inventory, in journey order: (1) dashboard Use template button (/design-release-2.1, T2) -> (2) Manage templates (/templates: intro, Create new template, My templates list of cards with View template and Use template, sort select, success banner after save/delete; T1, T8, T9, T10, T11) -> (3) template view (/templates/<slug>: caption Templates, name heading, Date created, Use template, Delete, review cards with Change links per section; T3, T5, T6, T8) -> (3a) change one section (/templates/<slug>/change/<page> redirects to the question page with ?from=template-review, Save and return / Cancel, back to the view with an 'has been updated' banner; T5) -> (3b) use (/templates/<slug>/use redirects to the notification hub as a new Draft GBN-AG reference; T4) -> (3c) edit (/templates/<slug>/edit opens the hub as a Template tasklist with no Documents section; T7) -> (3d) delete confirmation (/templates/<slug>/delete: Delete this template?, Name summary, Yes, delete / No, cancel; T8). Create journey (conditional on Create new template): /templates/create?new=1 redirects to (4) notification type (What are you importing?, back to /templates) -> (5) Enter template name (/templates/create, caption Create a new template) -> (6) origin of the import and what are you importing in template mode (caption Template + name) -> (7) the template's own task list (hub, Template tasklist) -> (8) Review your template (/review-notification, Save template, Delete to /templates/discard) -> Manage templates with 'saved to templates' banner. Guards: documents and declaration redirect away in a template (T9), /templates/save with no name saves 'Untitled template' (T10), (9) discard confirmation /templates/discard inside a template journey (T11) and its redirect to /templates outside one (T12), POST to a template page reloads it and an unknown template slug returns to the list (T6). All 12 traces passed with no errors, so no validation message renders anywhere in this part; the only conditional surfaces are the template-mode variants of shared pages.

The templates journey makes no calls to other systems: every request in the 12 traces is to the prototype itself (page GETs and form POSTs answered with 302 redirects) or to its static assets; templates are held in the prototype session.
claims.ref: requests of traces T1-T12 (e.g. T1 requests 1-39)
claims.quote: GET 200 templates ... GET 200 application.css ... localhost:3011?EIO=4&transport=polling
claims.note: The localhost:3011 calls are the prototype kit's browser-sync reload, not a service. Session storage is inferred from the session cookie on every request.
